an4.166:2.1: tatra bhikkhave yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā dandhābhiññā, ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭipadā ubhayeneva hīnā akkhāyati. yampāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā, imināpayaṃ hīnā akkhāyati. yampāyaṃ paṭipadā dandhā, imināpayaṃ hīnā akkhāyati.
an4.166:2.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭipadā ubhayeneva hīnā akkhāyati.
an4.166:3.1: tatra bhikkhave yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā khippābhiññā, ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭipadā dukkhattā hīnā akkhāyati.
an4.166:4.1: tatra bhikkhave yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā dandhābhiññā, ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭipadā dandhattā hīnā akkhāyati.
an4.166:5.1: tatra bhikkhave yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khippābhiññā, ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭipadā ubhayeneva paṇītā akkhāyati. yampāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā, imināpayaṃ paṇītā akkhāyati. yampāyaṃ paṭipadā khippā, imināpayaṃ paṇītā akkhāyati.
an4.166:5.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭipadā ubhayeneva paṇītā akkhāyati.
